title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | S&P 500 | US Stock Market Today |Live Updates: S&P 500, Nasdaq open higher as oil prices fall - The Economic Times
text:
US Market | Dow Jones Live Updates: US stocks open slightly higher on Friday, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq gaining while the Dow remains nearly flat. Investors weigh the impact of lower oil prices against higher Treasury yields. The S&P 500 rises 0.25% to 7,657.17, while the Nasdaq gains 0.39% to 26,522.09.

New York Stock Exchange withdraws alerts from its daily premarket update that inadvertently tag BlackRock, Citigroup, Intercontinental Exchange and Grupo Televisa in connection with Warren Buffett stepping down as Berkshire Hathaway chairman. The alerts were published in error, and there will be no substitute.

Xenon Pharmaceuticals fell nearly 27% in premarket trading after temporarily pausing enrolment in trials for an experimental treatment for major and bipolar depression following reports of side effects. Berkshire Hathaway said Warren Buffett would step down as chairman and become chairman emeritus. Alphabet and Nvidia gained about 2.5% and 0.7%, respectively, while Apple edged higher.
